stories.title: Dawood’s home in Bhendi Bazaar set to be demolished
stories.summary: Haji Ismail Habib Musafirkhana, the dilapidated building in South Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, which was once the home of fugitive underworld don Dawood Ibrahim and his family, is set to be demolished by the BMC. stories.title: Navi Mumbai police bust alleged Ponzi racket linked to Ayurvedic products

stories.title: BMC expands war on plastic flowing into Arabian Sea
stories.summary: The BMC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Netherlands-based nonprofit The Ocean Cleanup to expand its efforts to prevent plastic and other floating waste from entering the Arabian Sea. stories.summary: Around 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff.
